projetos.desc: Oracle monitoring tool for the terminal, built with Textual, with dedicated panels for RAC, Data Guard, ASM and Exadata and asynchronous collectors.
destaques: Asynchronous collectors — the interface never freezes waiting on a query
Coverage of RAC, Data Guard, ASM and Exadata

projetos.desc: Lab orchestrator based on Multipass VMs that provisions complete MySQL topologies for study and training — including failure and recovery scenarios.
destaques: Rich-based TUI menus and tmux log panels
Chaos and recovery scenarios to train troubleshooting

projetos.desc: Set of scripts and procedures for SQL Server administration — tempdb diagnostics, restore automation with dedicated stored procedures, and import/export routines via BCP.
destaques: Restore automation with dedicated stored procedures

projetos.desc: PostgreSQL administration scripts following the same conventions as the ecosystem's MySQL tools — session auditing, backup, performance and security.
destaques: Session auditing mirroring the conventions of the MySQL tools

projetos.tagline: Slow query log in AWR-style report
projetos.desc: Slow query log analyzer for MySQL, MariaDB and Percona. It normalizes queries, groups them by fingerprint and delivers a report in the terminal and in interactive HTML, in the style of Oracle's AWR.
destaques: Zero external dependencies — only the Python 3.6+ standard library
Reads .log, .gz, .zip or directly from the mysql.slow_log table
p50 to p99 percentiles, automatic callouts and index suggestions
SQLite snapshot to compare periods and spot regressions
HTML, JSON, CSV and text output, with --watch mode and alerts
